meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: 让 Claude 变成纯调度者：当你提供一份书面任务计划时，它把计划拆成小任务，同时派出多个子代理分别做编码、测试和检查，自己负责调度、验收和记账，绝不亲手实现或改文件，直到计划全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-execute”或“start work”，或明确要求执行 `.omo/plans` 下的某份计划时触发。如果没有现成计划，它会先自动生成一份再开始执行。

say.note: 启动技能并执行当前选中的计划。

say.text: 请运行 .omo/plans 里的重构计划
say.note: 定位到该计划并开始推进。
以拉取请求的形式交付每个阶段的成果。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator: it splits a plan into atomic tasks, spawns subagents to implement/test/QA each, and only handles scheduling, verdicts, and tracking. It never edits files itself; it runs until all checkboxes are done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'ulw-execute', asks to run a plan under .omo/plans, or says 'start work' without a plan (then it bootstraps a plan first).

say_en.note: Starts executing the currently selected plan.

say_en.text: Please run the refactor plan in .omo/plans
say_en.note: It finds and runs that plan.
Delivers each phase's work as a pull request.
